quest.title: Whispers by the Hearth
quest.description: Go to Hotel Bouffes d'ete, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Hotel Bouffes d'ete to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, I wasn't the most attentive host when you visited Snezhnaya before.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: There's no need for that, Lady Sandrone. Even if we never sat down for a chat, you always provided us with the best refreshments.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: *sigh* My apologies. I was too busy back then. I'll be sure to take better care of you the next time you visit.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mm. You never let me try out your inventions before, either.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: There were different reasons for that...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Actually, Father told us not to disturb you wherever possible.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Don't worry about that, I don't mind the occasional disturbance. You can come for tea whenever you feel like it.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Really? A—Actually... I've always wanted to ask you to take a look at Pers... I have some ideas for improvements that I'd like to run past you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Sure thing, that is my area of expertise, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, Lady Sandrone!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mm. Is being a Harbinger really so tough?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: When you put it like that... I suppose it is a little. There's a lot to consider. Though most of my frustrations stem from my colleagues...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: So that must mean... that getting along with others is a must-have skill?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I suppose so... But I doubt you have much to worry about in that regard. At least, Lyney certainly doesn't.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Haha, you flatter me, Lady Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Do you want to be a Harbinger? Actually... Never mind. It's not my place to ask. Just pretend I said nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hmm... That's all a little far off for me. I'm certainly in no rush to think about it yet.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: If you became a Harbinger, wouldn't that mean you'd have no time to accompany us on missions?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: In that case... Would that mean... Lynette and I would have to become Harbingers, too?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I told you, stuff like that is too far off to think about!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Besides, no matter where I go, I'll never leave you two behind. I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah... Sometimes I really envy this little family you have.

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Hotel Bouffes d'ete to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Thank you for your hospitality, Lady Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Alright, take care.
